definition: The primary annual federal income tax return filed by individual taxpayers to report wages, investment income, deductions, credits, and calculate total tax liability or refund.

includes.text: Contains line for total wages from wage and income statements
includes.quote: Total Amount From Form(s) W-2, Box 1

includes.text: Contains section for reporting tax and credits
Contains line for calculating refund or amount owed

excludes.text: Sibling reports mortgage interest paid by taxpayer
Sibling reports dividend and distribution income to taxpayer
Sibling is filed to correct errors on a previously filed return
excludes.quote: Amended U.S. Individual Income Tax Return

discriminators.text: Original return filed in current year; sibling is specifically for correcting errors on a previously filed return
Reports comprehensive individual income and tax calculation; sibling reports only mortgage interest paid during the year
Primary return reporting all income sources and tax liability; sibling reports only dividend and distribution income received
discriminators.quote: Total Income and Adjusted Gross Income
